review.decision: Expose the weighted admission limit through the read-only doctor
review.notes: Use private queue fixtures and share the production slot calculation. Keep the scan bound and replay integrity unchanged.

cases.description: Read-only usage tracks weighted admission and distinguishes the directory enumeration limit
cases.setup: Create a private queue with unresolved request and payload pairs plus unrelated names.
cases.action: Inspect an absent queue, a queue with one admission left, a saturated queue and a directory larger than the scan bound.
cases.expected: The report distinguishes names from reserved slots, agrees with admission before and after saturation and leaves queue contents intact. On scan overflow it reports only the observed lower bound.

cases.description: Doctor explains weighted saturation without suggesting deletion
cases.setup: Construct active spool usage snapshots in English and Chinese.
cases.action: Render healthy, low headroom, slot exhaustion, scan overflow and unavailable diagnostics.
cases.expected: Users can see active slots and the raw name count. Missing measurements are not represented as zero usage and the notes preserve unresolved and replay records.
